siat.description: Statistics Agency SIAT database: all statistical tables

nsdp.description: National Summary Data Page: IMF e-GDDS SDMX files (Statistics Agency, Central Bank, Ministry of Economy and Finance, stock exchange)

cbu_fx.description: Central Bank official exchange rates, daily since 1994

cbu_charts.description: Central Bank chart data: policy rate, UZONIA, money market, monetary operations, interest rates

cbu_stats.description: Central Bank statistics pages (cbu.uz/statistics): monetary and financial statistics, banking system, microfinance organisations and pawnshops, payment system, balance of payments and IIP (BPM6 standard presentation), statistical bulletin
cbu_stats.access: XLSX/XLS files linked from web pages

cbu_pos_archive.description: Central Bank statistical bulletins of 2018 and 2019, table 6.3: bank cards, POS terminals, ATMs and the amount of transactions through POS terminals as of the first day of each month, January 2017 to January 2020 (extends the monthly bulletin table 6.4 back by three years)
cbu_pos_archive.access: Values transcribed from the PDF bulletins into a reference file (ref/cbu_pos_archive) with edition, page and file checksum

nsdg.description: Statistics Agency national SDG platform (nsdg.stat.uz): national SDG indicators 2000-2024 with breakdowns, regions, national targets and reporting status
nsdg.access: Excel files linked from the goal pages

gender_stat.description: Statistics Agency gender statistics portal (gender.stat.uz): indicators by sex, region and age from the Agency's open-data API

stat_opendata.description: Statistics Agency data outside SIAT: the earlier open-data API (api.stat.uz), other Excel tables on stat.uz, 2026 agricultural census preliminary tables, and the SIAT release schedule

stat_regions.description: Statistics Agency regional departments (qrstat.uz, samstat.uz ...): district-level Excel tables of each region
stat_regions.access: Excel files linked from the departments' official-statistics pages

mof_budget.description: Ministry of Economy and Finance (imv.uz): tax rates, shares of regulating revenues assigned to local budgets, local budgets plan and execution by region, PPP agreements by region and sector, and the latest editions of recurring department tables (large taxpayers, health, education, social and agricultural spending)

openbudget.description: Ministry of Economy and Finance, Open Budget portal (openbudget.uz): state budget execution by tax, function, ministry and economic classification; consolidated budget; budget law; targeted funds; subsidies; local budgets by region; monthly execution by region and district; public debt by creditor, currency and sector; guaranteed debt; PSDS and GFS tables; participatory budget aggregates
openbudget.access: JSON API (openbudget.uz/api/v1, header hl) + Excel files (api/v2/info/file)

uzrvb.description: Republican Currency Exchange: FX trading sessions (weighted average rate and volume), interbank money market, inter-dealer REPO and secondary government-securities trading (daily totals), and results of government-bond, CBU-bond, deposit, REPO and currency-swap auctions and currency futures
uzrvb.access: HTML tables on the market pages

uzse.description: Tashkent Stock Exchange: daily UCI and sector price indices, market capitalisation and trading in index shares since August 2016; quotation list and bonds admitted to trading
uzse.access: JSON (index history), HTML and data embedded in pages

uzex.description: Commodity Exchange: weekly exchange quotes of the main commodities (fuels, metals, polymers, sulphur, cement, wheat, flour, cotton fibre and cotton-seed products)
uzex.access: JSON (quote history of each catalogue product)

procurement.description: Uzbek Commodity Exchange public procurement portals: value of public procurement by method and region (monthly and annual since 2024, daily totals) from the xarid.uzex.uz monitoring dashboard; etender.uzex.uz platform counters and active proposals by region

customs.description: Customs Committee: catalogue of its open datasets (declarations, exports, imports, customs payments, offences, clearance times and others) with their data.egov.uz download links; the statistical files are loaded when data.egov.uz is reachable

invest.description: Ministry of Investment, Industry and Trade (invest.gov.uz): industrial zones by region and district (zones, territories, useful/occupied/free area), portfolio of investment projects offered to investors, Uzbekistan-USA cooperation projects

stateassets.description: State Assets Management Agency: registers of enterprises with state participation (with state shares), KPI-system company list and headline financial results of state enterprises by period, and e-auksion.uz statistics of assets for sale under decree PF-70
stateassets.access: HTML tables (old.davaktiv.uz, kpi.davaktiv.uz) and JSON API (e-auksion.uz)

govuz.description: Ministries, agencies and khokimiyats on gov.uz: statistics tables and reachable Excel files from their open-data, statistics and budget-openness pages, appeals statistics, and a catalogue of their data.egov.uz datasets
govuz.access: JSON backend of gov.uz (api-portal.gov.uz) + Excel files

egov.description: Open Data Portal data.egov.uz: the datasets of about 180 state bodies (ministries, committees, agencies, banks, state companies, khokimiyats); tables with periods become time series in four languages, other tables are stored as published, registers over 5,000 rows are linked; the Statistics Agency's copies of SIAT tables are linked from the matching Hub datasets
egov.access: JSON API of the portal (no key). The site opens only from Uzbekistan: loaded from a snapshot made there with egov_fetch.py

uzhydromet.description: Uzhydromet (hydrometeorological service): open data, climate normals for the 13 regional centres, 1981-2010

worldbank.description: World Bank: every indicator with data for Uzbekistan - World Development Indicators, International Debt Statistics (also by creditor, with scheduled debt service), Worldwide Governance Indicators, Global Findex, Quarterly External Debt Statistics, Global Economic Monitor, education, gender, health, jobs, social protection, population projections, ICP, PEFA and 30 more World Bank databases
worldbank.access: JSON API and bulk CSV (api.worldbank.org v2, no key)

wb_pinksheet.description: World Bank commodity prices (the Pink Sheet): monthly prices of about 70 commodities in US dollars since 1960 (energy, food, fertilizers, metals, gold) and the World Bank commodity price indices; the gold price enters the GDP nowcast
wb_pinksheet.access: Excel workbook linked from the Commodity Markets page (worldbank.org/en/research/commodity-markets)

imf.description: IMF data portal: World Economic Outlook with projections (current release and archived vintages), Regional Economic Outlook, consumer and producer prices, exchange rates, reserves, monetary and financial statistics, financial soundness, national accounts, balance of payments and IIP (BPM6), trade in goods by partner, direct and portfolio investment by partner, government finance statistics, public debt and the Fund's accounts with Uzbekistan
imf.access: SDMX 2.1 data and SDMX 3.0 structure API (api.imf.org, no key)

adb.description: Asian Development Bank Key Indicators Database: about 530 indicators for Uzbekistan by KIDB topic, and gross regional product and labour force by region (14 regions)

ilostat.description: ILOSTAT: all labour statistics for Uzbekistan (about 240 annual indicator tables plus quarterly and monthly employment and CPI), including ILO modelled estimates to 2030
ilostat.access: CSV files from the ILOSTAT API (rplumber.ilo.org, no key)

unsdg.description: UN Global SDG Indicators Database: all SDG series for Uzbekistan, one dataset per goal (per target for large goals)

comtrade.description: UN Comtrade mirror trade: partner countries' reported imports from and exports to Uzbekistan, and Uzbekistan's own reports by partner (annual totals in US dollars since 1992)
comtrade.access: JSON API (comtradeapi.un.org public preview, no key, one year per call)

satellite.description: Satellite indicators for Uzbekistan (monthly national means): night-time light radiance (VIIRS Day/Night Band), vegetation indices NDVI and EVI (MODIS) and tropospheric NO2 (Sentinel-5P TROPOMI); the night lights enter one experimental GDP nowcast model
satellite.access: CSV file supplied by IMRS (ref/satellite), replaced when a newer export is supplied

backlog.title: Dual-source check tables (national vs international values with gap flags)
backlog.notes: 2026-09-29: Cross-check page (uzdata/crosscheck.py): 19 key indicators compared across national and international sources with gap flags.

backlog.title: Asian Development Bank Key Indicators, national and regional
backlog.notes: 2026-09-29: connector adb: 529 KIDB indicators plus regional GRP and labour force by region.

backlog.title: Tashkent Stock Exchange: price indices and trading results
backlog.notes: 2026-09-29: connector uzse: UCI and sector indices, market capitalisation, trading, quotation list, bonds.

backlog.title: Republican Currency Exchange: FX, interbank and government securities results
backlog.notes: 2026-09-29: connector uzrvb: FX sessions, money market, REPO, government securities auctions and trading.

backlog.title: Commodity Exchange quotes
backlog.notes: 2026-09-29: connector uzex: weekly quotes of main commodities; procurement statistics in connector procurement.

backlog.title: Central Bank statistics pages and bulletin (Excel)
backlog.notes: 2026-09-29: connector cbu_stats: monetary, banking, payment system, microfinance, BOP/IIP and bulletin tables, 99 datasets.

backlog.title: Ministries' and khokimiyats' open-data sections on gov.uz
backlog.notes: 2026-09-29: connector govuz: numeric tables and reachable Excel files of 76 of 336 bodies, appeals statistics, and a catalogue of 445 data.egov.uz links. Excel attachments on api-portal.gov.uz (about 3,350 files) return HTTP 403 from outside Uzbekistan: see item govuz_excel.

backlog.title: Ministry of Economy and Finance: public debt and budget execution pages
backlog.notes: 2026-09-29: connectors openbudget and mof_budget: budget execution, local budgets, public debt by creditor/currency, GFS, tax rates, PPP.

backlog.title: ILOSTAT labour indicators for Uzbekistan
backlog.notes: 2026-09-29: connector ilostat: 258 ILO indicator datasets.

backlog.title: UN SDG database series for Uzbekistan
backlog.notes: 2026-09-29: connector unsdg (UN global database) and nsdg (national SDG platform).

backlog.title: Privatisation statistics (e-auksion.uz)
backlog.notes: 2026-09-29: connector stateassets: e-auksion privatisation statistics by region and status (aggregates), SOE registers and KPI results.

backlog.title: Regional statistics departments (14 sites)
backlog.notes: 2026-09-29: connector stat_regions: 11 regional departments, 630 district-level tables. andstat.uz, navstat.uz and toshvilstat.uz refuse connections from abroad; farstat.uz fails TLS verification.

backlog.title: Mirror trade: partner countries' reported trade with Uzbekistan (UN Comtrade)
backlog.notes: 2026-10-01: connector comtrade: 2 datasets (comtrade-mirror-partners: 320 series of partner countries' reported imports from and exports to Uzbekistan; comtrade-uzb-reported: 342 series of Uzbekistan's own reports by partner), annual 1992-2025, 7,694 values in US dollars. Commodity detail and monthly data left out (preview API limits).

backlog.title: Corporate disclosures register (openinfo.uz)
Legislation and draft regulations (document library)
RAR and 7z archives attached on gov.uz (182 files)
backlog.notes: Needs py7zr and rarfile+unrar in the environment; then extend govuz.py to open them.

backlog.title: Tashkent Stock Exchange: price history of each listed security

backlog.title: CERR analysis (review.uz)
backlog.publisher: Center for Economic Research and Reforms
backlog.blocked_reason: CERR and review.uz publish articles, paid PDF journals and image infographics; cerr.uz/open-data lists no items (checked 29 Sep 2026). IMRS (imrs.uz) likewise publishes PDFs and images only.

backlog.title: Open Data Portal (data.egov.uz), about 13,100 datasets of 179 bodies
backlog.notes: 2026-09-30: 9,446 datasets stored (1,665 series, 7,741 tables, 40 large registers linked), 1,050 Statistics Agency copies linked to SIAT tables. The site refuses connections from abroad: the fortnightly cloud run keeps the data; a refresh needs a computer in Uzbekistan (see connector_notes/egov.json).

backlog.title: Tax Committee statistics (soliq.uz)
backlog.blocked_reason: soliq.uz refuses connections from outside Uzbekistan. Needs a collector running inside Uzbekistan.
backlog.notes: 2026-09-30: the Tax Committee's 40 datasets on data.egov.uz are loaded by the egov connector (the 2 largest registers as links); soliq.uz itself remains unreachable.

backlog.title: Excel attachments of ministries and khokimiyats on gov.uz (about 3,350 files)
backlog.blocked_reason: The file server answers HTTP 403 (nginx) to .xlsx/.xls requests from outside Uzbekistan, while it serves PDFs. The govuz connector loads them automatically once they are reachable.

backlog.title: Ministry of Agriculture (agro.uz), Ministry of Employment (mehnat.uz), cadastre agency (kadastr.uz), Ministry of Justice (minjust.uz), Chamber of Accounts (ach.gov.uz)
backlog.blocked_reason: Refuse connections from the cloud (connection reset). minjust.uz and ach.gov.uz answered from a computer in the region, agro.uz, mehnat.uz and kadastr.uz did not.
backlog.notes: 2026-09-30: their datasets on data.egov.uz (Ministry of Agriculture 33, Ministry of Employment 32, Ministry of Justice 33 and others) are loaded by the egov connector; the websites themselves remain unreachable from abroad.

backlog.title: my.gov.uz: public services statistics by region and district
backlog.blocked_reason: The API accepts only requests signed by the site's own app (error 1100011).

backlog.title: Air quality archive (Uzhydromet)
backlog.blocked_reason: monitoring.meteo.uz shows only the latest readings; the archive API requires a signed agreement.
